title.en: AN ACT SEPARATING THE SITIO OF SONGKOY FROM BARANGAY POBLACION IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF KITCHARAO, PROVINCE OF AGUSAN DEL NORTE, AND CONSTITUTING IT INTO A DISTINCT AND INDEPENDENT BARANGAY TO BE KNOWN AS BARANGAY SONGKOY

text.en:
Creation of Barangay Songkoy. - The sitio of
Songkoy is hereby separated from Barangay Poblacion in the
Municipality of Kitcharao, Province of Agusan del Norte and
constituted as a distinct and independent barangay to be known
as Barangay Songkoy.

2

Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite.
plebiscite conducted and supervised by the Commission
on Elections (COMELEC) pursuant to Provincial Ordinance
No. 155-2004 of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of the Province
of Agusan del Norte, which ratified the creation of Barangay
Songkoy as proclaimed by the Plebiscite Board of Canvassers on
October 16, 2004 shall serve as substantial compliance with the
plebiscite requirement under Section 10 of the Local Government
Code of 1991, as amended.

Incumbent Barangay Officials. - The incumbent
elected barangay officials of Barangay Songkoy shall continue to
hold office until such time that their successors have been duly
elected and qualified.

Public Infrastructure and Facilities. - All public
infrastructure and facilities existing therein at the time of the
approval of this Act are hereby transferred without cost or
compensation to and shall be administered by the new
Barangay Songkoy.

Internal Revenue Allotment Shares. - Barangay
Songkoy shall be entitled to internal revenue allotment (IRA)
shares pursuant to Section 285 of the Local Government Code of

3

Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15)
days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper
of general circulation.
